import subprocess, os, struct, time

VNCDO = r'"C:\cits\venv\Scripts\vncdo.exe" -s localhost::5900 -p cits2026'
SS_DIR = r'C:\cits\logs\screenshots'
os.makedirs(SS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

def vncdo(cmd, timeout=15):
    r = subprocess.run(f'{VNCDO} {cmd}', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    print(f'vncdo({cmd[:40]}): rc={r.returncode} err={r.stderr[:100]}')
    return r.returncode == 0

def screenshot_size(name):
    path = fr'{SS_DIR}\\{name}.png'
    r = subprocess.run(f'{VNCDO} capture {path}', shell=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, encoding='cp932', errors='replace')
    try:
        sz = os.path.getsize(path)
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            hdr = f.read(24)
        if len(hdr) >= 24 and hdr[:8] == b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n':
            w = struct.unpack('>I', hdr[16:20])[0]
            h = struct.unpack('>I', hdr[20:24])[0]
            print(f'{name}: {sz}b {w}x{h}')
        else:
            print(f'{name}: {sz}b NOT_PNG')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{name}: ERROR {e}')

screenshot_size('before_unlock')

# Ctrl+Alt+Del でロック解除を試みる
print('Sending Ctrl+Alt+Del...')
vncdo('key ctrl-alt-Delete')
time.sleep(3)
screenshot_size('after_ctrl_alt_del')

# もしパスワード入力画面が出ていればパスワードを試みる
# Administrator よく使われるパターン:
# VNCパスワードと同じ? cits2026
# または空 (Windows auto-login)
print('Trying Enter (empty pass or auto-login)...')
vncdo('key Return')
time.sleep(2)
screenshot_size('after_enter')

print('Done.')
